query.description: Search query text. Used to generate embedding.

qdrant_url.description: URL of the Qdrant server. Set this in the tool configuration, not by the agent — the agent never sees or sets this value.

qdrant_api_key.description: API key for Qdrant. Leave empty if the server does not require one. Set this in the tool configuration, not by the agent — the agent never sees or sets this value.

openai_api_key.description: OpenAI API key used for embeddings. Set this in the tool configuration, not by the agent — the agent never sees or sets this value.

filter_by.description: Optional metadata field to filter by.

filter_value.description: Optional metadata value to filter by.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.
